card.line: Ziklag was a city in southern Judah that a Philistine king gave to David, and it was his home while he waited to become king.

moments.title: Achish gives David Ziklag
moments.text: David asked Achish for a town of his own, away from the royal city. Achish gave him Ziklag, and it has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

moments.title: Ziklag burned and taken
moments.text: David and his men came home to find Ziklag burned down by the Amalekites. Their wives and children had been carried off, and the men wept until they had no strength left. David found strength in the LORD his God.

moments.title: Gifts from the plunder
moments.text: After David won back what was taken, he returned to Ziklag. He sent part of the plunder as gifts to the elders of Judah and to his friends in many towns.

moments.title: News of Saul's death
moments.text: David stayed in Ziklag two days after the fight with the Amalekites. Then a man came from Saul's camp and told him that Saul and Jonathan were dead. David and his men tore their clothes, mourned, and fasted.

moments.title: Mighty men join David
moments.text: While David was still kept away from Saul, skilled fighters came to him at Ziklag. Some were archers and slingers from Saul's own tribe of Benjamin.
